title: Get Live Room User Portraits
content:
# Path: /analytics/202502/live_rooms/{live_room_id}/user_portraits
# Method: [GET]
# Function Description
Returns user portrait indicators for the specified live room, including age, gender, fan, advertisement, and region distributions.

---


# Common Parameters
For common parameters, refer to [How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/64f199679495ef0281851ee5#Back%20To%20Top)
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Location <!-- width:75px --> | Type <!-- width:75px --> | Require <!-- width:60px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| content-type | header | string | Y | application/json | Allowed type: application/json |
# Request Path Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Require <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| live_room_id | string | Y | 7274599999999999999 | The ID of the live stream room whose user portrait indicators are requested. |
# Request Query Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Require <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| app_key | string | Y | 38abcd | Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app. |
| sign | string | Y | 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c | Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders. |
| timestamp | int | Y | 1623812664 | Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time. |
# Request Sample
**Query**
```Plain Text
https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202502/live_rooms/7274599999999999999/user_portraits?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268
```

# Response Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:289px --> | Properties description <!-- width:289px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | int | 0 | The success or failure status code returned in API response. |
| message | string | Success | The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message. |
| request_id | string | 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 | Request log |
| data | object |  | Specific return information |
| ^all_ads_gender_indicators | []object |  | Gender indicators for advertisement |
| ^^type | string | USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_UNKNOWN | The gender category represented by this indicator. |
| Possible values: |  |  |  |

* USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_UNKNOWN: Unknown gender.
* USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_M: Male.
* USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_F: Female. |
   ^^value |string |123 |The count for the corresponding gender indicator. |
   ^all_fan_indicators |[]object | |Fans indicators |
   ^^type |string |USER_PORTRAIT_FOLLOWER |The stats_type describes the type of value below.

USER_PORTRAIT_FOLLOWER: The user portrait of the follower
USER_PORTRAIT_NON_FOLLOWER: The user portrait of the non follower |
^^value |string |123 |The count for the corresponding follower-status indicator. |
^all_ads_age_indicators |[]object | |Age indicators for advertisement |
^^type |string |USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_LESS_THAN_15 |The type of age indicator.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_LESS_THAN_15: Users whose age is less than 15.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_MORE_THAN_34: Users whose age is more than 34.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_MORE_THAN_55: Users whose age is more than 55.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_13_TO_17: Users whose age is between 13 and 17.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_15_TO_17: Users whose age is between 15 and 17.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_18_TO_24: Users whose age is between 18 and 24.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_25_TO_34: Users whose age is between 25 and 34.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_35_TO_44: Users whose age is between 35 and 44.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_45_TO_54: Users whose age is between 45 and 54. |
^^value |string |123 |The count for the corresponding age indicator. |
^region_indicators |[]object | |Country-level user portrait indicators for the live room. |
^^value |string |123 |The share for the corresponding indicator, scaled by 10,000. Divide by 10,000 to obtain the underlying proportion. |
^^type |string |ID |The country of indicators
|
^paid_ads_age_indicators |[]object | |Paid advertisement age indicators for advertisement |
^^type |string |USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_LESS_THAN_15 |The type of paid advertisement age indicator.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_LESS_THAN_15: Users whose age is less than 15.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_MORE_THAN_34: Users whose age is more than 34.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_MORE_THAN_55: Users whose age is more than 55.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_13_TO_17: Users whose age is between 13 and 17.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_15_TO_17: Users whose age is between 15 and 17.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_18_TO_24: Users whose age is between 18 and 24.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_25_TO_34: Users whose age is between 25 and 34.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_35_TO_44: Users whose age is between 35 and 44.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_45_TO_54: Users whose age is between 45 and 54. |
^^value |string |123 |The count for the corresponding paid-advertising age indicator. |
^paid_ads_gender_indicators |[]object | |Paid advertisement gender indicators for advertisement |
^^type |string |USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_UNKNOWN |The gender category represented by this indicator.
Possible values:

* USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_UNKNOWN: Unknown gender.
* USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_M: Male.
* USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_F: Female. |
   ^^value |string |123 |The count for the corresponding paid-advertising gender indicator. |
   ^paid_fan_indicators |[]object | |Paid fans indicators |
   ^^type |string |USER_PORTRAIT_FOLLOWER |The stats_type describes the type of value below.

USER_PORTRAIT_FOLLOWER: The user portrait of the follower
USER_PORTRAIT_NON_FOLLOWER: The user portrait of the non follower |
^^value |string |123 |The count for the corresponding paid follower-status indicator. |
